documents.title: User stories — Decision ladder (T2)
documents.body:
# User stories — Decision ladder (T2)

## Personas

- **The programme administrator / policy author** — writes the platform `decision_policy` and the tenant `decision_policy_refinement`.
- **The approver** — decides at L3; their approval must read as the same record as a rule's.
- **The board member** — applies a draft through the gated `ladder.apply_draft` action.
- **The auditor** — reads every decision, whatever its rung, and re-derives it from its pins.
- **The laya tenant** — owns a `laya_inference_config`; the choice is asked in their own scope.
- **The delivery leads on T3, T5, T7, T13, T16** — consume the ladder's actions.

## Stories

- As a policy author, I want one `decision` record with rungs L0–L3, so that a rule, a laya choice and a human approval are comparable without a join.
- As a laya tenant, I want my choice asked under my own `laya_inference_config`, so that latency, confidence and provenance belong to my scope.
- As a programme administrator, I want to publish a versioned refinement that overrides a threshold, so that a threshold change needs no build or deploy.
- As an auditor, I want every decision to pin its policy, refinement and laya config versions, so that a superseded input cannot make the record unreproducible.
- As a board member, I want a generated draft to reach a card only through a gated action, so that generation cannot move work on its own.
- As a delivery lead on T3, T5, T7, T13 or T16, I want the ladder actions to exist, so that my routing, remedy, candidate, metering and job decisions start from a shared record.

## Scenarios

```gherkin
@verify=T2.1
Scenario: a rule, a laya decision and a human decision share one audit shape
Given one tenant with an L0 rule outcome, an L1 laya choice and an L3 human approval
When all three are recorded through ladder.evaluate and ladder.record
Then each row carries rung, policy, option-set version, answer, confidence, actor and latency, and only the values differ
```

```gherkin
@verify=T2.2
Scenario: a refinement changes a threshold without a code change
Given a platform policy at min_confidence 0.8 that refuses a 0.7 answer
When the tenant publishes an approved refinement at 0.5
Then the identical input is accepted and no code or deploy changed
```

```gherkin
@verify=T2.3
Scenario: every decision pins the refinement and laya config versions
Given a decision taken under refinement v1 and laya config v1
When v2 of each is published afterwards
Then the stored row still names v1/v1 and a write with any pin missing is refused
```

```gherkin
@verify=T2.4
Scenario: a generated draft does not compile into a transition
Given the GeneratedDraft result type and the card transition entry point
When a draft is offered where a Move is expected
Then it does not compile, proved by the compile_fail doctest
```

```gherkin
@verify=T2.5
Scenario: a stored draft cannot transition a card without its gate
Given a stored draft artefact
When an action tries to apply it to a card
Then the attempt is refused and the only accepted path is ladder.apply_draft behind an accepted L3 draft.apply gate, which leaves a decision record
```

## Verify

- T2.1 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_rule_a_laya_and_a_human_decision_share_one_audit_shape`
- T2.2 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_refinement_changes_a_threshold_without_a_code_change`
- T2.3 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder every_decision_pins_the_refinement_and_laya_config_versions`
- T2.4 — `cargo test -p conveyor-domain --doc GeneratedDraft`
- T2.5 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_generated_draft_cannot_transition_a_card`

## Links

- Plan: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §7.1–§7.5, §12 T2; issue #73.

## Notes

Reconstructed for standard v4 on 2026-11-28 from #73's record and the delivered code. The issue's own `rbuild` route is retired; the test identities above are the ones it named.

## Scenarios


```gherkin
@verify=T2.3

Given a decision taken under refinement v1 and laya config v1
When v2 of each is published
Then the stored row still names v1/v1 and a write with any pin missing is refused
```

```gherkin
@verify=T2.4
Scenario: a generated draft does not compile into a transition
Given the card transition entry point and the GeneratedDraft type
When a draft is offered where a transition input is expected
Then it does not compile, proved by the compile_fail doctest
```

```gherkin
@verify=T2.5
Scenario: a stored draft cannot transition a card
Given a stored draft artefact
When an action tries to apply it to a card
Then the attempt is refused and the only accepted path is the gated ladder.apply_draft action that leaves a decision record
```

## Verify commands

- T2.1 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_rule_a_laya_and_a_human_decision_share_one_audit_shape`
- T2.2 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_refinement_changes_a_threshold_without_a_code_change`
- T2.3 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder every_decision_pins_the_refinement_and_laya_config_versions`
- T2.4 — `cargo test -p conveyor-domain --doc GeneratedDraft`
- T2.5 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_generated_draft_cannot_transition_a_card`

## Results

All five scenarios passed at `a2a47d1`, one row per scenario in #73's evidence table. The tree carries them: `crates/actions/tests/decision_ladder.rs` holds the four integration tests and `crates/domain/src/ladder.rs` holds the `compile_fail` doctest on `GeneratedDraft`. The schema landed as `0046_decision_ladder.sql`, renumbered from the planned 0045 at merge, with the ladder's later slices adding `0071_ladder_option_sets.sql`, `0086_ladder_laya_provenance.sql`, `0099_step_decisions.sql` and `0103_ladder_option_set_union.sql`. The actions live in `crates/actions/src/ladder/mod.rs`: `ladder.prepare|evaluate|record|list|apply_draft`, `decision_policies.create|update|list`, `refinements.publish|list`, `laya_configs.create|list` — open question 2 resolved in favour of the `ladder.*` split. The laya client landed with signed requests: a forged key is refused and a tampered request does not verify. P3.1's wire replay under the pins stays the laya client's slice; slice 1 evaluates an injected confidence.

## Status

met — #73 is closed with all five scenarios passing at `a2a47d1`; the tests and the migration set are in the tree. There is no local Rust compile gate (rbuild retired 2026-11-20); a re-run goes through the repository's preflight.

## Links

- Plan §7.1–§7.5, §12 T2; #73; `seed/programme.json` T2 gate.

documents.title: Definition of ready — Decision ladder (T2)
documents.body:
# Definition of ready — Decision ladder (T2)

## Independent

T2 consumes T0's five decision-family tables (`migrations/0040_organisation.sql:216-360`) and T1's merged base; it creates its own migration, its own `crates/actions/src/ladder/` module, its own `crates/domain/src/ladder.rs` and its own test file, so it shares no file with a concurrent delivery. The four parts are file-disjoint and sequenced inside the one issue: schema, recording and evaluation, version pins, generation split.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed — the four claims of the seed's `meta.gate`. The action namespace was open at readiness: the ADR family already owned `decisions.*`, so the split (`ladder.*`, `decision_policies.*`, `refinements.*`, `laya_configs.*`) was recorded as open question 2 with a default and adopted at delivery, amending §10.4.

## Valuable

T2 removes the named gap: the three decision shapes were separate tables (`audit_event`, `run_step.judge`, `approval_decision`) and no store module inserted a `decision`. It satisfies the seed gate and unblocks T3, T5, T7, T13, T16 and T12.

## Estimable

Baseline `main@87639c0`, measured 2026-11-17. The issue's current-state table names each part's evidence, including four ABSENT findings — zero-file `git grep` counts for the refinement, the version pins and the generation types. Every file to create is named: the ladder migration (planned 0045, delivered 0046), `crates/actions/src/ladder/`, `crates/domain/src/ladder.rs`, `crates/actions/tests/decision_ladder.rs`.

## Small

One issue #73, one branch `issue/73-decision-ladder`, one PR. Five criteria across four parts; the out-of-scope list holds the consumers (T3, T4, T5), the prompt compiler, budget and metering.

## Testable

Every criterion carries a named test or doctest with a per-criterion command. The integration tests run against a real Postgres fixture (`support::Pg`, `support::Running`, `support::Seeded`) and a laya stub; the type-level proof is a `compile_fail` doctest.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: #72 (T1) — merged `e3d7c4e`, closed 2026-11-17; the seed's `depends_on` also names P0.
- blocks: #74 (T3), #77 (T5), #78 (T7), #76 (T13), #85 (T16), #88 (T12).
- related: #46, whose ADR queue is superseded by #243 (merged `59e2e04`).

## Notes

Reconstructed for standard v4 on 2026-11-28; the project's closed state and the issue's measured table are the record's.

# Definition of done — Decision ladder (T2)

## Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Evidence | Verify |
|---|---|---|
| T2.1 a rule, a laya decision and a human decision share one audit shape | #73 row: pass at `a2a47d1`; `crates/actions/tests/decision_ladder.rs` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_rule_a_laya_and_a_human_decision_share_one_audit_shape` |
| T2.2 a refinement changes a threshold without a code change | pass at `a2a47d1`; gated `refinements.publish` in `crates/actions/src/ladder/mod.rs` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_refinement_changes_a_threshold_without_a_code_change` |
| T2.3 every decision pins the refinement and laya config versions | pass at `a2a47d1`; `0086_ladder_laya_provenance.sql` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder every_decision_pins_the_refinement_and_laya_config_versions` |
| T2.4 a generated draft does not compile into a transition | pass at `a2a47d1`; `compile_fail` doctest in `crates/domain/src/ladder.rs` | `cargo test -p conveyor-domain --doc GeneratedDraft` |
| T2.5 a stored draft cannot transition a card without its gate | pass at `a2a47d1`; `ladder.apply_draft` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test decision_ladder a_generated_draft_cannot_transition_a_card` |

## Evidence at completion

#73 is closed; all five scenarios passed at `a2a47d1`, one row per scenario in the issue. The schema landed as `0046_decision_ladder.sql`, renumbered from the planned 0045 at merge, and the ladder's later slices added `0071_ladder_option_sets.sql`, `0086_ladder_laya_provenance.sql`, `0099_step_decisions.sql` and `0103_ladder_option_set_union.sql`. Open question 2 is resolved: the delivered actions are `ladder.prepare|evaluate|record|list|apply_draft`, `decision_policies.*`, `refinements.*` and `laya_configs.*`.

## Repo gate

The issue's gate named `rbuild --gate`; that route is retired (owner 2026-11-20). The local gate is non-compiling — `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo metadata --locked` and actionlint on changed workflows — and the compile/lint verdict comes from the repository's GitHub-hosted `preflight.yml` and the PR's CI. The migrations are numbered against the served sequence; the renumber from 0045 to 0046 is the collision handled at merge.

## Merge and closure

One PR `Closes #73` merged; #73 is closed; the seed reads T2 `status: closed` and `measured_status: built`. The lane is `issue/73-decision-ladder`.

## Links

- Plan `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §7.1–§7.5, §12 T2; #73; `seed/programme.json` T2.
